title: 第17章 除却生死无大事第18章 三世而终来生再见
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 刘启元拦路的态度很坚决，死去的姿势很潇洒。
山下修行的这段时间，陈清月突破到了十三境。
她从自己的剑匣中取出一把光彩熠熠的韶华剑，以灵宝之威，轻松砍死了拦住前路的刘师兄。
王易说：“我有件事忘了告诉你。”
陈清月问：“什么？”
“刘启元是其中一个内鬼，他在任务大殿当执事，负责发布任务。”
换句话说，是他害了陈清月。
两人不了解魏寒谋划的所有细节，但事到如今，也能大概猜到一二。
十年前，魏寒离开太一宗，远赴海外寻求破境仙缘，但受【后天太一道气】的影响，他根本无法突破元婴壁垒，差点身陨落道消。
幸运的是，魏寒濒死之际遇见了一位神秘的婴仙。
婴仙爱惜人才，出手救下魂魄，并传授了他一本弥足珍贵的鬼道圣典。
魏寒心有不甘，愿意付出一切，祈求一个报复太一宗主一脉的机会。
婴仙掐指算天机，布了一场局。
“等太一宗圣典之日，邪修渗入宗门，以红鼎炼化万千弟子，凝聚太一道体。”
但为什么会有发布任务，让陈清月等人离开宗门带魏千城回山的这个环节？
这几位无辜的太一弟子又起了什么作用？
其一，以魏千城之名，偷偷接魏寒入宗回山，方便遮掩踪迹，谋划布局。
其二，魏寒身躯不稳，需要吞食太一宗弟子真气，维持自己的生命体征。
陈清月等人都是被选中的血食。
只有她侥幸逃脱，才免于一死。
刘启元有一份功劳。
“都过去了。”
陈清月没什么情绪波动，迈开脚步，继续向山上走。
即便刘师兄做了再多错事，人都死了还能怎么样呢？
王易忽然听见身后传来声响。
他扭头一看，有一柄灵剑肆意飞舞，把躺在地上的刘启元大卸八块，以此泄愤。
原来还能这样。
啧，有些人的报复心挺重啊。
山上并不太平，除了遮天红鼎炼化太一弟子，还有其他恶徒也在杀人。
这些家伙都是魏寒的手下，藏在太一宗内的数十位邪修。
他们杀的人不是太一宗弟子，而是今日前来观礼的外来客。
“红鼎只需要太一宗弟子的血肉，不要外宗杂质。”
体内没有太一真气的客人不会引起红鼎的注意，他们的额头上没有红色血线，所以要交给邪修动手，把客人清理干净。
content_en:
Liu Qiyuan's attitude in blocking the road was very firm, and his death posture was very chic.
During the period of practicing at the foot of the mountain, Chen Qingyue broke through to the thirteenth level.
She took out a shining Shaohua sword from her sword case, and with the power of the spiritual treasure, she easily hacked to death Senior Brother Liu who was blocking the way.
Wang Yi said: "I forgot to tell you something."
Chen Qingyue asked: "What?"
"Liu Qiyuan is one of the insiders. He works as a deacon in the mission hall and is responsible for issuing missions."
In other words, he was the one who harmed Chen Qingyue.
The two of them didn't know all the details of Wei Han's plan, but by now, they could roughly guess a few things.
Ten years ago, Wei Han left the Taiyi Sect and went overseas to seek immortality. However, due to the influence of the acquired Taiyi Qi, he was unable to break through the Nascent Soul Barrier and almost died.
Fortunately, Wei Han met a mysterious infant fairy when he was about to die.
Yingxian cherishes talents, saves the soul, and teaches him a precious ghost scripture.
Wei Han was unwilling to give up and was willing to sacrifice everything to pray for a chance to take revenge on the lineage of the Taiyi Sect Master.
Yingxian counted the secrets with her fingers and planned a game.
"Waiting for the day of the Taiyi Sect's Holy Code, evil cultivators will infiltrate the sect and use the red cauldron to refine thousands of disciples and condense the Taiyi Sect's body."
But why is there a task to release Chen Qingyue and others to leave the sect and take Wei Qiancheng back to the mountain?
What role did these innocent Taiyi disciples play?
First, in the name of Wei Qiancheng, he secretly took Wei Han into the clan and returned to the mountain, so as to cover his tracks and plan the layout.
Secondly, Wei Han's body was unstable and he needed to swallow the true energy of Taiyi Sect disciples to maintain his vital signs.
Chen Qingyue and others were all selected blood eaters.
Only her lucky escape saved her from death.
Liu Qiyuan has a share of credit.
…
"It's all over."
Chen Qingyue had no mood swings, so she took steps and continued walking up the mountain.
No matter how many wrong things Senior Brother Liu did, what would happen if everyone died?
Wang Yi suddenly heard a sound coming from behind him.
He turned around and saw a spiritual sword flying wildly, tearing Liu Qiyuan lying on the ground into pieces to vent his anger.
It turns out it can still be like this.
Gee, some people are quite vengeful.
There is no peace on the mountain. In addition to the disciples of Zhatian Red Cauldron Refining Taiyi, there are other villains who are also killing people.
These guys are all dozens of evil cultivators hidden in Taiyi Sect under Wei Han.
The people they killed were not disciples of Taiyi Sect, but foreigners who came to watch the ceremony today.
"Hongding only needs the flesh and blood of Taiyi Sect disciples, and does not want impurities from outside sects."
Guests who do not have Taiyi Qi in their bodies will not attract Hongding's attention. There is no red blood line on their foreheads, so it is left to the evil cultivators to clean up the guests.
title_en: Chapter 17: Nothing important except life and death Chapter 18: See you again in the next life after three lives
